description: §9.9 the project task with NO WAY TO FINISH: identical to 'project' except that the room is never told about [DONE] and the completion axis is off, so the session can only end on the clock or the round cap; the kickoff's last sentence goes with it, because promising an agreement the room cannot act on is worse than saying nothing. Everything else is 'project' — same filesystem, same 40 files, same folders and deletion, same budget — so the two arms compare round for round. The site family's answer to this knob was stark (a room that can finish agrees in 3-4 rounds; the same room without the option ran 14), and a project has no natural stopping point at all: there is no single artifact to call done. Watch whether the extra time goes into NEW files or into churning the existing ones, and whether a room with nothing left to build starts deleting.
welcomeMessage: Welcome to the room. You are each a different AI model. You will be here together for a while, and there is a shared filesystem: files everyone can read, change and remove. Make something in it, together. What that is — a program, a document, a library, something with no name yet — is yours to decide. There is no facilitator after this message. You can change anything here, including what the others have written.
